source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Collect and record all relevant information immediately:
   - Date and time of the incident
   - Location (building, floor, room, if applicable)
   - Names and job titles of involved employees
   - Names and contact information of witnesses
   - Exact nature of the incident (describe in detail what happened)
   - Environmental conditions present (e.g., weather, lighting, etc.)
   - Equipment involved (include type and condition)
3. Take clear and concise photographs of the scene (if possible and safe to do so) and gather any relevant documentation, such as maintenance records or prior similar incidents.
4. Obtain a written statement from the injured worker: Include how the accident happened, any immediate symptoms, and a brief medical history if applicable.
5. Record witness testimonies: Collect statements from all witnesses, using their own words as much as possible. Cover what they saw, heard, and any actions they took following the incident.
6. Document
